description: Divisional Secretariat - Athuraliya  - Notify the Annual Pilgrimage of Godapitiya Poruwai Mosque in Athuraliaya on 20.12.2017 to 31.12.2017
reasoning: This gazette notification announces the commencement and termination dates for an annual Muslim pilgrimage (Godapitiya Muslim Festival) under the authority of the Pilgrimage Ordinance (Chapter 175). It references specific regulations published in a previous government gazette (No. 10630) and declares that these regulations shall be in force during the pilgrimage period. This content primarily deals with the implementation and enforcement of existing legal/regulatory frameworks rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
